content_blocks.text: The Executive Committee of the Procurement Lawyers’ Association is pleased to announce that the deadline for submission of essays in this year’s competition has been extended to 5pm on Friday 30th July 2021. We recognise this can be a particularly busy time of year and we hope that this extension will allow those contemplating writing an essay some more time to do so.
